loadCorrection: Refresh algebraically bound roots before residual checks, bridge-before-tail solve order, 4..12 bounded adaptive passes; re-embed after contact. No deleted yarns, stopped wind or relaxed strain gate.
renderCorrection: Bound physical GPU command batches and poll fences with timeout zero; preserve primitive order, all geometry and all samples, keep one uploaded physical snapshot and present only the completed image. Incomplete offscreen frames are cancelled on input changes. Default GPU watchdog remains enabled; no retry-to-pass.
renderTimingCaveat: Physical-frame GPU elapsed query spans cooperative scheduling gaps; not GPU busy utilization or a consumer-device FPS benchmark.
scope: Cut the existing visible hole out of the sheet force graph and area/mass model
Bind retained bridges and tails as two-way/one-ended low-resolution chains
Connect thickness, declared areal mass and directional stiffness to solver
Keep R11 rest appearance, sampling and LOD behavior
limits: Existing static hole, not force-created tearing or adaptive topology
Point/sphere collision only; no self collision, CCD or full garment/person integration
Unmeasured material heuristics; finish color and washing are not measured mechanics
Additional yarn dynamics has CPU cost; worker separation does not eliminate that cost
Bounded submission avoids one giant GPU job but adds scheduling overhead; no universal device stability claim
Sewing remains visual geometry, not true piercing or seam tension
No independent instance seed, local patch streaming, film time cache or film color pipeline
Browser/resource bookkeeping is not full process memory or consumer GPU FPS
Original archive, R01-R11 and unrelated workbenches unchanged; no merge or force push
